subject: Recap & next steps: cost window + procurement checkpoints for ClearHealth pilot
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Torres <sam.torres@clearhealth.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & next steps: cost window + procurement checkpoints for ClearHealth pilot

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and the items we promised to pull together so your FinOps and procurement teams can validate feasibility. Short summary below, then proposed next steps.

What we heard you need
- Pilot footprint: ~1M-5M inferred tokens/month during the 8-week proof-of-concept (estimate from your demo usage patterns)
- Target unit economics: you indicated target around $100–$200 / 1M tokens for inference (including model + infra)
- Procurement constraints: PO process kicks in at ~$50k ARR equivalent (team needs a PO for anything >$50k annually); preferred net-45 payment terms

Initial pricing posture (ballpark)
- For the pilot size above we can target a blended rate of ~$150 / 1M tokens. That assumes standard hosted instances with selective quantization and no additional customization.
- We can provide $10k in pilot credits to reduce your upfront spend while you validate latency/quality.

Open questions for finance/procurement
- Is the PO threshold you mentioned a hard gate or negotiable for pilots?
- Who on your side will own the PO and contract signoff? (you mentioned Elena in finance)

Attachments we will send
- RWI-pricing-estimate-CLH-v1.xlsx (ballpark pricing, token bands, step-down for committed volumes)
- ClearHealth-MAP-v1.pdf (mutual action plan with milestones & dates)

Proposed next steps
1) I’ll share the two attachments after a quick internal check with Ben/Monica (below).
2) Can we schedule a 30-min FinOps sync with Elena and your procurement lead next week (Wed/Thu preferred)?
3) If procurement wants a PO < $50k to start, we can discuss a short-term contract or prepay option to move faster.

Ben/Monica: tagging you for pricing confirmation and whether we can relax the standard PO expectation for pilots (and confirm pilot credit language).

Sam — I’ll follow up with the files in a couple hours.

Thanks,
Chloe Martin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Sam Torres <sam.torres@clearhealth.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Park <elena.park@clearhealth.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps: cost window + procurement checkpoints for ClearHealth pilot

Chloe — thanks for the succinct recap. Helpful. A few clarifying items from our side:

- The 1M–5M token estimate aligns with internal expectations during pilot. If quality/regressions require more sampling we may see spike weeks — can you confirm how overage is treated during pilot?
- PO threshold: $50k is standard but our procurement team can sometimes issue an exception for a timeboxed pilot if legal signs off. I looped Elena (Finance) to see if we can accelerate.
- Payment terms: net-45 is preferred; are net-45 or net-30 options available for enterprise deals?

If you can include an example pricing band for 1M, 3M, and 5M token buckets (and the assumed latency SLO) that would help our CFO. Also please indicate whether the $10k pilot credit can be applied to the first invoice or used as an offset for overages.

Happy to take the MAP/estimate and then set the FinOps call. Wed afternoon looks possible for us.

Thanks —
Sam
Head of Product Integrations | ClearHealth
sam.torres@clearhealth.ai | +1 (617) 555-3344

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 12:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps: cost window + procurement checkpoints for ClearHealth pilot

Chloe / Monica — quick internal note on pricing and procurement flex:

Pricing buckets (recommended for estimate)
- 1M tokens/mo: $220 / 1M tokens (pilot rate, pay-as-you-go)
- 3M tokens/mo: $165 / 1M tokens (committed monthly band discount)
- 5M tokens/mo: $140 / 1M tokens (higher commit, includes backend cache optimization)

Pilot credits and overages
- We can deliver $10k pilot credit applied to the first invoice (reduces invoice amount; any remaining credit can be used against month 2 overages).
- Overage treatment during the pilot: bill at pay-as-you-go rate for the month and then reconcile; if overage is expected we offer a short-term cap with advance notification.

Procurement levers
- PO threshold: standard policy is PO required for >$50k ARR equivalent. For pilots we can accept signed SOW + invoice (no PO) if legal approves; Monica can help with an internal exception template.
- Payment terms: Net-45 is acceptable for pilot SOWs; enterprise deals typically default to Net-30 but we can negotiate.

I attached the pricing worksheet (RWI-pricing-estimate-CLH-v1.xlsx) and a MAP draft. Suggest we send both to Sam/Elena with the 1/3/5M bands called out.

Ben
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: RWI-pricing-estimate-CLH-v1.xlsx
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Torres <sam.torres@clearhealth.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Elena Park <elena.park@clearhealth.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps: cost window + procurement checkpoints for ClearHealth pilot

Hi Sam / Elena — following up with the requested materials and a suggested path to get the pilot contracted quickly.

Attached:
- RWI-pricing-estimate-CLH-v1.xlsx — includes the three token bands Ben outlined and assumptions for latency SLOs and caching.
- ClearHealth-MAP-v1.pdf — mutual action plan with milestones (kickoff, 2-week quality check, pilot wrap + handoff).

Key points from the pricing sheet (high level)
- 1M tokens/mo: $220 / 1M tokens (pilot pay-as-you-go)
- 3M tokens/mo: $165 / 1M tokens (monthly commit)
- 5M tokens/mo: $140 / 1M tokens (larger commit with performance tuning)
- $10k pilot credit applied to first invoice; unused credit rolls into month 2 as offset.
- Overage: billed at the tiered pay-as-you-go rate; we can put a pre-agreed cap during the pilot if you want a hard ceiling.

Procurement options to accelerate
- Option A: Standard SOW + invoice (no PO) for the pilot; legal signs SOW and procurement issues PO for larger follow-on commitment. This is the fastest path and acceptable to Redwood for pilots.
- Option B: If procurement requires a PO up-front, consider a limited prepay or short-duration PO that keeps the initial spend below your $50k threshold.

Next steps
1) Please confirm whether Elena can join a 30-min FinOps call Wednesday 18 Jun at 10:00 AM ET (I preserved the slot we discussed).
2) If procurement prefers Option A, I’ll circulate the SOW and we can get signatures the same day.
3) If you want the pricing sheet updated with any adjustments (e.g., stricter latency SLO, on-prem data controls), reply with the note and Ben/Monica will iterate.

Quoted for context:

Looking forward — we want to make the procurement path as frictionless as possible so your team can start validating production metrics.

Best,
